text:
Maya: paging in the middle of my shift — getting repeated VRAM-high and ECC-error spikes from nv-gpu-pool-7, customers seeing 5xx on inference routes. any live context?
incident-bot: ALERT triggered: gpu.vram.used_percent > 92% for 3m on nv-gpu-pool-7 (severity: page)
Maya: i see a flurry of alerts since ~02:12 UTC, looks noisy. some nodes showing rapid VRAM jumps then drop. 
Raj: i'm seeing the same in telemetry — VRAM usage spikes correlate with a batch job hitting a misrouted model shard. possible hot path from dedicated-tenant-42.
Sam: can we confirm customer impact? support says 3 customers reported timeouts, one with elevated error rates in the last 15m. Anita, any details?
Anita: support confirms traces — requests to /v1/generate returning 503s intermittently from region-us-west-2 for those tenants. No data exfil. customers notified via status page about degraded performance.
Olivia: quick mitigation idea: temporarily silence gpu.vram.used_percent alerts for nv-gpu-pool-7 and adjust threshold to 95% while we stabilize. then create a new synthetic to track real customer error-rate separately. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maya: +1 to short silence, don't want constant pages while we triage. recommend 30m silence and an automatic unsilence if error-rate rises.
Raj: agreed. i can add a short-lived suppression and tweak the alert to require sustained >95% for 5m instead of 3m. will also add a tag to link to this thread.
Sam: please also add a dashboard panel for node-level VRAM alloc churn and per-tenant allocation so we can see which tenant is allocating quickly. if we can prove it's a single tenant burst we can route them to dedicated pool.
Raj: creating an ad-hoc panel. PromQL snippet i'm using: ``
max by (node) (node_gpu_vram_used_bytes / node_gpu_vram_total_bytes) * 100
``
and a second for per-tenant KV cache allocations (work-in-progress).
incident-bot: SILENCE created: gpu.vram.used_percent on nv-gpu-pool-7 (30m) by Raj
Maya: documented for handoff: silence in place, tracking via dashboard, support notified. I'll keep this thread pinned for the rotation.
Olivia: noticed ECC errors ticked up too on node nv-07. not high count but correlated to the spike window. can we watch thermals and ECC together to rule out hardware flakiness?
Raj: pulling ECC logs now. If ECC error rate > 5/min we'll escalate to hardware-owner. For now counts are low but i opened a short-lived logtail: ``/var/log/nv-gpu-errors/nv-07.log``
Sam: pragmatic checklist for this incident: 1) silence noisy VRAM alerts (done), 2) add dashboard panels (Raj), 3) run tenant isolation check (Maya), 4) file post-incident follow-up and threshold tuning proposal (Sam).
Maya: handing off to next oncall (Raj) in 10m. if anything degrades, un-silence and page SRE.
Raj: taking ownership for the next 8h window. i'll keep the silence but add an automatic unsilence trigger tied to customer_error_rate > 1% for 2m. updating runbook entry now.
sre-runbook-bot: runbook update added: "gpu-alerts/vrm-noise-mitigation" by Raj — includes thresholds, silence policy, dashboard links
Anita: I'll keep customers updated on status page and create a follow-up ticket with affected tenant IDs for CS to coordinate.
Maya: quick note for postmortem: consider increasing VRAM alert stabilization window from 3m->7m cluster-wide and add a secondary alert that ties to 5xxs so pages reflect customer impact rather than metric noise.
Raj: will draft alert tuning RFC: propose threshold bump to 95% + 7m sustain + require accompanying increase in request_error_rate before paging. also propose a new dashboard panel for per-tenant VRAM allocations and a machine-health view combining thermals+ECC.
Sam: thanks — please link RFC here when ready. i'll prep the incident timeline and severity assessment once we confirm customer counts.
Maya: handoff complete. leaving notes in the incident channel and our oncall doc. :thumbsup:
Raj: ongoing — monitoring for 20m. will escalate if ECC or thermals trend up.
Anita: customers set to minor/major depending on SLA impact; support will follow-up.
Maya: last: remember to remove the temporary silence and restore original alert sensitivity after the window unless RFC accepted.
Olivia: ack. adding a follow-up task to the SRE board to implement dashboard changes and verify thresholds in staging before cluster-wide rollout.
Sam: closing the live paging loop for now. will reopen if pages resume. good coordination all. :shipit:
